tagline: Leading global nitrogen fertilizer and chemicals producer
hero_kpi_rationale: The 31.3% gross margin reflects CF's ability to monetize rising prices in the global nitrogen market despite higher natural gas costs, signaling strong commercial discipline and a favorable market position amid geopolitical disruptions.

kpis.name: Gross Margin Percentage
kpis.explanation: Consolidated gross margin as a percentage
kpis.description: Gross margin increased due to higher selling prices partially offsetting higher natural gas costs

kpis.name: Net Sales
kpis.description: Consolidated net sales increased due to higher global nitrogen selling prices and volume gains

kpis.name: Cost of Sales
kpis.description: Cost of sales increased due to higher realized natural gas costs, including the impact of realized derivatives

kpis.name: Gross Margin per Product Ton
kpis.explanation: Average gross margin per ton of product sold (Ammonia segment)
kpis.description: Gross margin per ton increased as selling price growth outpaced unit cost increases
kpis.signal: Higher gross margin per product ton

kpis.name: Sales Volume by Product Tons
kpis.explanation: Consolidated sales volume in thousands of product tons (Ammonia segment)
kpis.description: Sales volume increased due to improved availability following less severe winter production outages compared to 2024

kpis.short: Average Selling Price per Product Ton
kpis.name: Average Selling Price per Product Ton
kpis.explanation: Average selling price per ton of product (Ammonia segment)
kpis.description: Average selling price increased due to strong global nitrogen demand and geopolitical disruptions

kpis.name: Depreciation and Amortization
kpis.description: Depreciation and amortization increased moderately due to capital expenditure investments

kpis.short: Unrealized Net Mark-to-Market Loss on Natural Gas Derivatives
kpis.name: Unrealized Net Mark-to-Market Loss on Natural Gas Derivatives
kpis.explanation: Unrealized net loss on natural gas hedging derivatives (Ammonia segment)
kpis.description: Natural gas price volatility resulted in an unrealized loss on derivative positions

risks.title: Cybersecurity
risks.score_rationale: Cybersecurity risk is mentioned in Item 1A regarding computer systems, with moderate language intensity. While relevant to operations, this risk does not represent a major strategic threat to CF Industries compared to critical operational risks.

risks.title: Regulatory and Compliance
risks.score_rationale: CF is subject to complex regulations related to hazardous raw materials (notably AN used in explosives), environmental emissions, and safety standards. Regulatory changes could significantly impact margins and operations.

risks.title: International Competition
risks.score_rationale: The nitrogen market is highly competitive globally, with major producers in Egypt, Iran, and Russia. Despite current geopolitical disruptions creating a favorable dynamic, the competitive landscape remains significant.

risks.title: Natural Gas Price Volatility
risks.score_rationale: Natural gas represents a major cost factor for CF (up to 60% of production cost). Natural gas price volatility directly impacts gross margins and profitability, as evidenced by gains/losses on derivatives.
